_comment: Live catalog freshness is current status (stale false with refresh_seconds=0); static rows stay null. No age assertion to avoid timed flakiness.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[catalog]
url = "{UPSTREAM}/catalog"
timeout = 5
refresh_seconds = 0
headers = { "X-Catalog-Token" = "cat-secret" }

[catalog.model_providers]
"cat-1" = "chatup"

paths.data.1.metadata.router.sources.routing.v: configured transport and adapter paths only

name: m4_capability_catalog_freshness_live
